title: Backtest optimal risk-scaling thresholds
problem: Current thresholds (0.50 full size, 0.85 skip) chosen by intuition. Should backtest different threshold pairs on historical data to find optimal win rate / participation trade-off.
solution: Built scripts/backtest_risk_scaling.py testing (full,skip) threshold pairs on V4 across A/B/C/D. Best per account: A=(0.60,0.95) $1,285 PF1.71 +$135; B=(0.40,0.75) $459 PF1.24 +$216; C=(0.55,0.85) $627 PF1.35 +$6; D=(0.40,0.75) $459 PF1.24 +$900 (D==B by geometry). Default (0.50,0.85) within ~10% of best on A/C, within ~50% on B/D where tighter thresholds help most. Decision: keep (0.50,0.85) as default — gains modest, overfit risk, model quality is the real bottleneck (V4+v6 ensemble @0.50 robustly passes PF>1.5 on B/D where risk-scaling alone on V4 maxes at PF 1.24). Artifact: ψ/lab/risk-scaling-2026-06-28/ (result.txt includes A/B/C/D + README.md).

title: DP set_time fix not verifiable in backtest — need synthetic worst-case test
problem: DrawdownProtector.set_time() was added to fix daily_pnl not resetting in backtest (used real wall-clock time). Code-wise correct, but DP never fires in backtest because daily_start_equity resets to peak_equity on rollover — for profitable strategies (PF 4-5, WR 90%), daily limit grows with peak ( -> peak  -> daily limit ) making it unreachable with  risk/trade. No synthetic test exists that forces DP to fire to prove the mechanism works correctly. The fix is verified only by code reading, not by behavior.
solution: Causal proof test written: tests/test_dp_set_time_backtest.py (11 tests). CPT protocol: hypothesis=set_time drives rollover+cooldown expiry in backtest; without it daily_pnl never resets and cooldown never expires. RED verified via monkeypatching set_time to no-op → 7 of 11 tests fail. GREEN: all 11 pass with fix. Test classes: TestSetTimeCausalProof (3 tests — with vs without set_time behavior must differ), TestSetTimeRollover (3 — daily/weekly reset), TestSetTimeCooldown (2 — cooldown expiry), TestSetTimePeakDrawdown (1), TestBacktestLoopPattern (2 — full backtest loop with/without set_time). Artifact: tests/test_dp_set_time_backtest.py
notes: Found in retro 2026-07-01; file ref: broky/risk/drawdown_protection.py:323; learning: 2026-07-01_dp-daily-limit-pegs-to-peak.md

title: DB close before MT5 close → orphan position + PnL lost
problem: In _monitor_positions (L926) and _execute_tp1_close (L1054), close_live_trade + CB.record_win/loss + DP.record_pnl all run BEFORE bridge.close_position. If MT5 close fails (caught + logged warning only), DB says is_open=0 but MT5 still holds position. Realized PnL from actual MT5 deal never written back. Kill switch reads stale PnL → fires late or never on Real-A.
solution: Reordered: _close_mt5_position helper (L819) closes MT5 FIRST, returns bool. _monitor_positions (L960) + _execute_tp1_close (L1079) only call close_live_trade + CB.record + DP.record after True. On False: leave DB open + retry next cycle. Verified by tests/test_live_trader_critical_round2.py::TestCloseMt5PositionHelper (3 tests).

Matches closing deal via 3 strategies (deal.order==ticket, position_id==ticket, price proximity). Wired into _monitor_positions and _execute_tp1_close. 3 causal tests in tests/test_live_trader_external_close_reconcile.py (RED to GREEN). title: raw rpyc _check_existing_position skips initialize() — returns None when MT5 terminal shutdown
problem: Both swing trader (live_trader.py:803) and m5_scalp trader (m5_scalp_trader.py:523) use raw rpyc.connect() + conn.root.positions_get() WITHOUT calling conn.root.initialize() first. MT5Bridge wrapper used by live_collector calls initialize() then shutdown() each cycle (fetch_candles_sync), so the MT5 terminal in Wine flips between initialized and shutdown states. When traders check positions while terminal is shutdown, positions_get returns None (not []). The traders treat None as 'bridge disconnected' and hold off new trades — but actually the bridge is fine, just not initialized. Race condition: timing decides whether trades happen. Verified hypothesis: calling initialize() before positions_get returns real account_info + list of positions.
solution: Added conn.root.initialize() call before conn.root.positions_get() in both raw rpyc code paths (live_trader.py:_check_existing_position line 803, m5_scalp_trader.py:_check_existing_m5_scalp_position line 523). Try/finally ensures shutdown() is called to leave terminal in clean state for next caller. If initialize() fails, falls back to existing 'bridge down' behavior. Causal tests in tests/test_check_position_initialize.py prove initialize() is called before positions_get() (RED→GREEN). Direct verification on Real-A: 5/5 rpyc calls from oracle-engine to mt5a succeeded with initialize=True, positions returned as list (not None). Regression: 709 tests passed.
notes: Found 2026-07-07 during post-deploy verification. Bug affects both swing and m5_scalp. Fix: use MT5Bridge wrapper or add explicit initialize() call before positions_get in raw rpyc paths.

title: Reconcile picks wrong deal — missing time filter (ISSUE-080)
problem: _match_closing_deal (db.py) and _reconcile_external_close (live_trader.py) Strategy 1 (price proximity) does NOT filter deals by time. When two trades cluster in a price neighborhood, an earlier trade's SL/TP close (which happened BEFORE this trade opened) can be the closest in price to this trade's entry, so Strategy 1 picks it. Bridge does not expose position_id/entry fields so Strategy 0 (position_id match) is unusable. Result: DB records wrong exit_price/pnl/exit_reason. On Real-A 2026-07-08: trade #5543 BUY @ 4124.679 — DB recorded exit=4132.34 pnl=+$7.66 (profit!) but MT5 actually closed at 4112.76 pnl=-$11.92 (loss). 3 of 9 Real-A trades had wrong exit data.
solution: Added OPEN deal time lookup (deal.order==ticket AND deal.type==opening_type) before Strategy 1. Strategy 1 now filters closing deals by deal.time > open_deal_time, excluding earlier-trade closes. 3 causal tests RED→GREEN. Fix applied to both _match_closing_deal (db.py) and _reconcile_external_close (live_trader.py). docker-compose: separate ML_FILTER_ENABLED_A env var for oracle-engine.
notes: CPT: tests/test_reconcile_time_filter.py. Learning: ψ/memory/learnings/2026-07-08_reconcile-time-filter.md. Fix: open_deal_time lookup (deal.order==ticket AND type==opening_type) + filter deal.time > open_deal_time in Strategy 1.
